definition: A point passes only if the server starts from cold on the verified card and completes one request whose prompt and output tokens match exact server accounting at the intended horizon, with clean post-request ownership.

source.command: python -m hipengine.server --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1100 --quant gguf_q4_k_m --kv-storage bf16 --max-context-tokens 2048 --max-active-requests 1 --speculative-mtp-serving off --prefix-cache off

device.selection_note: card resolved by pci_id through hipengine.util.amdgpu_vram; server-reported ordinal cross-checked against the request

result.reason: server started and completed one validated request

kv_capability.reason: BF16/default KV does not require approximate-KV capability evidence

metric_note: Whole-card used VRAM sampled from sysfs mem_info_vram_used during startup and the request. Samples are lower bounds on transients shorter than the sampling interval.
